title: How Much Does TubeBuddy Cost? 2026 Pricing Guide
summary: TubeBuddy pricing tiers are broken down here so you can determine which subscription level aligns with your channel's growth and budget requirements.
body_markdown:
## TubeBuddy pricing and plan features


### The Free starter tier limits


The Free version is a restricted testing environment where the platform locks most advanced search and optimization tools. Users can access basic channel milestones and limited keyword search results, but they cannot perform bulk updates or detailed A/B testing.


A creator on the free plan must still manually edit every video description and tag one by one, preventing any real gains in workflow speed.


### TubeBuddy Pro vs Legend plan comparison


Basic productivity tools and limited SEO features appear in the Pro plan. To unlock the high-leverage automation that justifies the software's presence in a professional workflow, the Legend plan is required.


For creators managing a growing library, the Pro plan's lack of bulk processing keeps them tethered to repetitive tasks. The Legend tier provides A/B testing for thumbnails and titles, which allows a producer to use data to salvage underperforming uploads.


**$6.00 monthly is the cost** for the Pro plan, or $4.80 when billed annually, while channels with under 1,000 subscribers pay $3.00, which means smaller creators receive a significant discount to encourage early adoption.


[Webbizkb](https://webbizkb.com/video-marketing/tubebuddy-50-off-sale/) ’s analysis shows that TubeBuddy targets the "Rising Star" demographic with a 50% discount to lock in loyalty before the creator reaches the full-price threshold, ensuring the platform secures long-term customers while they are still building their audience, which guarantees a predictable revenue stream from emerging influencers, meaning the company prioritizes future market share over immediate profit margins.


Once a channel crosses 1,000 subscribers, the cost of maintaining the same efficiency tools **more than doubles** .


### Defining the unit of automation


The run is the meter, not the steps inside it. While legacy tools tax the builder for adding complexity, Activepieces charges 1 credit per flow run on its published pricing page, regardless of how many steps a creator builds into their YouTube sync.


> The run is the meter, not the steps inside it.


This ensures that a sophisticated ten-step production workflow costs exactly the same as a basic two-step alert, removing the penalty for breaking automation into the smaller, more reliable segments that professional channel management requires.


A flow run represents a single execution of an automation from start to finish. If a creator sets up a workflow that triggers every time they upload a video to YouTube, one upload equals one flow run.


A credit is the currency used to pay for that execution, meaning the user pays for the successful outcome of the task rather than the number of tools or filters used to achieve it.


### Enterprise for multi-channel networks


Designed for large-scale media companies and Multi-Channel Networks (MCNs), the Enterprise tier is a bespoke solution for those requiring centralized management for dozens or hundreds of channels.


It removes the per-channel billing overhead found in the lower tiers, allowing a single brand manager to oversee a vast portfolio from one dashboard.
